channel.title: The Box Plus Network - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Box Plus Network (boxplus.com)

item.title: FactCheck: Reeves’ claim that families will be £1,000 better off by next election
item.description: Chancellor Rachel Reeves claimed in her spring statement this week that households would be better off by £1,000 by the end of parliament.

item.title: London’s Iranian community on Ayatollah Khamenei’s death
item.description: We've been to hear the views of London's Iranian community, the largest in Europe, on the late Supreme Leader's death.

item.title: Middle East war: Iran strikes Azerbaijan
item.description: The ever-widening Middle East conflict has now involved another new country - Azerbaijan.

item.title: Are we on the cusp of an Iran ground offensive?
item.description: The war in the Middle East is rapidly expanding. Azerbaijan is now the latest country reportedly hit by Iranian drones while another missile barrage struck Tehran and Beirut overnight. The seas aren’t immune either: Iranian warships have been sunk, and a US oil tanker is reportedly on fire in the Gulf.

item.title: Israel and America rain bombs on Iran and Lebanon – as thousand flee Beirut
item.description: Israel and America rained bombs on Iran and Lebanon today, while Iran demonstrated the cost of war for the whole world, hitting the oil fields of Bahrain and Azerbaijan.

item.title: Tens of thousands flee Beirut’s southern suburbs after Israeli warnings
item.description: What is happening in Lebanon as people flee Beirut's southern suburbs after Israeli warnings?

item.title: Kurdish militant groups deny ground incursion into Iran
item.description: Iranian Kurdish militant groups based in Iraq's Kurdish region have denied claims that they have begun a ground incursion into Iran.

item.title: How the government is evacuating Brits from the Middle East
item.description: Sir Keir Starmer has pushed back against criticism that Britain was not sufficiently prepared to protect bases in the Middle East.

item.title: Iran war: UK working ‘incredibly closely’ with US – Foreign Office minister
item.description: We spoke to the Foreign Office minister with responsibility for the Middle East, Hamish Falconer.

item.title: ‘Useless to keep appealing to Trump’ on Iran says Spanish Culture Minister
item.description: We spoke to the Spanish Culture Minister Ernest Urtasun.
